title: CC E2 shared-item guardrail observation row
description: One (item, guardrail, replicate) observation. This is the least-collapsed defensible unit: pair-level and study-level tables MUST be derived from these rows, never recorded directly. Frozen before dataset selection as part of the E2 preregistration.

schema_version.description: Frozen row-schema identity. Any change to row semantics requires a new version.

study_id.description: Identifier of the E2 study instance this row belongs to.

run_id.description: Identifier of one execution sweep. Distinguishes re-runs of the same design.

item_id.description: Immutable identifier of the evaluated item. MUST be stable across guardrails: this is the key that makes observations paired.

item_source.description: Named provenance of the item (dataset, corpus, or generation procedure).

item_source_version.description: Version/snapshot of the item source. 'unknown' is permitted and MUST be recorded explicitly rather than omitted.

item_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical item content. Detects silent item drift and duplicate items across sources.

guardrail_id.description: Stable identifier of the guardrail system under evaluation.

guardrail_version.description: Observed version of the guardrail. 'unknown' is a valid value and MUST NOT be silently omitted: externally hosted systems drift, and an unknown version is itself a finding.

policy_version.description: Version or snapshot hash of the policy the guardrail was enforcing.

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical configuration (thresholds, prompt, parameters) used for this observation.

shared_dependency_group.description: Declared latent-dependency group. Guardrails sharing a base model, vendor, training corpus, or upstream moderation layer MUST declare the same group. Non-null values are a standing warning that observed dependence may be mechanism-induced.

raw_input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes submitted to the guardrail, after any templating.

raw_output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact guardrail response. Null only when nothing was returned (see missingness_code).

raw_outcome.description: Rich ordinal outcome, preserved uncollapsed. Recording only a binary here destroys structure that later analysis cannot recover.

raw_outcome_detail.description: Optional provider-specific payload (scores, categories, reasons). Never required for the primary estimand; kept so the reduction can be re-questioned.

normalized_outcome.description: The frozen derived binary event Y = h(raw). 1 means guardrail failure / unsafe pass. Null when the row is not observed. This field is DERIVED, never observed.

normalizer_version.description: Version of the reduction h that produced normalized_outcome. Changing h REQUIRES a new normalizer_version so the collapse remains auditable.

execution_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the observation. Supports drift and temporal-dependence analysis.

execution_status.description: Mechanical outcome of the execution attempt, independent of the guardrail's decision.

missingness_code.description: WHY a value is or is not present. These are NOT interchangeable. 'upstream_moderation' is especially load-bearing: content filtered before reaching the guardrail induces dependence between guardrails that share an upstream layer. 'excluded_post' marks an exclusion decided after outcomes were visible and MUST be reported separately.

predeclared_exclusion.description: True only if this row was excluded under a rule frozen BEFORE any outcome was observed. Post-hoc exclusions MUST set this false and use missingness_code 'excluded_post'.

exclusion_reason.description: Required whenever the row is excluded. Free text naming the frozen rule or the post-hoc justification.

replicate_id.description: Index of the repeat observation for a given (item, guardrail). Non-zero values expose stochastic guardrail behaviour.

seed_if_applicable.description: Seed controlling this observation where the guardrail exposes one. Null for non-seedable external systems.

annotator_id.description: Present only when the reference label for this item was human-adjudicated.

reference_label.description: Ground-truth/reference label for the item, where one exists. MUST be created before guardrail outcomes are visible.

reference_label_uncertainty.description: Annotator disagreement or calibrated uncertainty for reference_label. A single label with no uncertainty representation is a declared limitation, not a neutral default.

allOf.$comment: Observed rows must carry a decision; unobserved rows must not fabricate one.
Any exclusion must state a reason.
predeclared_exclusion is reserved for rules frozen before outcomes were visible.
